tips.text: Run the final Concert solo; a squad makes it three or four times longer for one extra Heartcell per Coda.
Vanquish the Coda at the Concert, never Convert; only a Vanquish pays Heartcells.
Bring Revenant, Nyx, Rhino, Dante, Styanax, Inaros or Grendel to the Concert; Limbo's Rift does not protect you from the stage hazards.
Kill DJ RoM first in a Duet; his Toxin skips shields and he is the one who downs people.
Slot Quick Correct once you know the Antivirus; each correct stab has a 10% chance of a bonus Heartcell.
Abort right after a correct-Antivirus stab; the progress banks, but a Quick Correct Heartcell is lost.
Mercy your Duet before it stumbles three times; a leftover Coda blocks everyone else's spawn in a public squad.
Hunt the Duet inside the Antivirus Bounty so one run pays Hex standing, Antivirus mods and disinfection.
Don't abort a Duet mission that was likely to spawn one; failing it resets the spawn chance.
Run the Antivirus Bounty on Steel Path for extra standing.
Farm Heartcells even when Eleanor shows the wrong batch; they do not expire.
Don't fret over the element of a roll; Elemental Vice swaps it later.
Expect about an hour per Coda once you know the loop; players call it the easiest adversary farm.
